official_definition: Clash X - All your Spirits gain the following effect: (When Attacks) Opposing Spirits/Ultimates must block, if possible. When a blocking Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed/depleted, send an opposing Life to the Trash.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Clash X] or [Clash X: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Clash X]", "give [Clash X]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
